name: Hinode
tagline: Tokyo in 14 minutes and Toranomon in 14 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥140,000 to ¥150,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, served by Yurikamome. Journey times to the main business districts are 21 minutes to Otemachi, 29 minutes to Shinjuku, 27 minutes to Shibuya and 18 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. The station stands 2.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 4.6 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 2.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.3 m to 5.9 m, a difference of 4.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. For storm surge, 3 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 3 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 芝公園かみやまクリニック, about 12 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 愛育病院, about 12 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
congestion: Yurikamome runs at 92% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 汐留→竹芝, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. 1LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000 and 2LDK ¥350,000 to ¥360,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Hinode, but Takeshiba is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Hinode. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Hinode. One-room rents run about ¥30,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Hamamatsucho is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is, but Hinode is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Hinode. It reaches Otemachi 9 minutes sooner than Hinode.

notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended

noiseSources: 新橋日の出ふ頭線 (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
海岸通り (4 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 11 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Neither the station nor the ground around it falls inside the projected flood area.
leads.stationNote: Only the Yurikamome serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
